description: Shut the book on the tally.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Dropped a jug, named sixpence, and charged the spill double.
name: Agnes Tipping

description: Named eight-and-twenty shillings and shut the book on the sum.
name: John Heminges

description: Stayed on you, and would not open a quarrel over the jug.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Read standing, roared the tyrant, said thou, and spilled.
name: Will Kemp

description: Laid the sheets down, put in the best of him, and named no day.
name: William Shakespeare
